senses.gloss: m. (v. next w.) any means of charming; art, contrivance. Tanḥ. Lekh 15 (play on מִגֵּן, Gen. XIV, 20) מ׳ עשה הקב״ה וכ׳ (ed. Bub. ib. 19 מגינה, corr. acc.) the Lord made a charm …, for Abraham took dust &c.
